notes.title: Sakura Knight 3 releases soon!
notes.notes:
Deep in the woods, in a withered glade where the grass is dead and nothing grows, a disturbance is lurking. The fierce half-dragon, Saga, once an underling to the feared demon queen who ruled over Lemuria, is beginning to gather forces to avenge her fallen leader.

Will Estelle and her party be able to stop Saga - and will Estelle finally be able to settle down with a cute girlfriend or three?

notes.title: Sakura Succubus 2 - Coming Soon
notes.notes:
Did you enjoy Sakura Succubus? Then there is good news for you:
Sakura Succubus 2 will be released in July!

But does he have enough time and energy to give these women what they want and how will Ayu, Cosmos and Marina react?

notes.title: Sakura Knight 2 - Coming soon!
notes.notes:
[b]Sakura Knight 2 is coming soon, so here is a little look at the plot of the sequel:[/b]

With her mother's sword retrieved and a party of pretty and capable women to support her, our plucky young heroine Estelle tries to make a name for herself in Grimoire, Lemuria's biggest city. Together with the ditzy elf Felicia, the mischievous catgirl Tart, and the affectionate wolfgirl Rune, Estelle takes on quests at Grimoire's guild, fights off hordes of wicked plant and slime monsters, and hones her swordplay.

Though her journey got off to a rocky start, things are finally starting to look up for Estelle. Perhaps she'll be able to accomplish her dreams after all!
